description: Update a SWSD incident sub-task. Pass incident_id (internal id or incident number), task_id, and name, assignee_email, due_at (ISO datetime), and/or is_complete. Only provided fields are sent. WRITE — honors SWSD_WRITE_MODE and does not retry on transient failure.

assignee_email.description: Email of the SWSD user to assign the task to.

due_at.description: Due datetime in ISO 8601 with a timezone.

incident_id.description: SWSD incident reference. Accepts either the internal id (>=7 digits, e.g. 180457930) or the human-facing number (<=6 digits, e.g. 60310). The handler auto-detects via digit count.

name: swsd_update_task
